relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 and METTL14 form a stable heterodimer that constitutes the core of the m6A methyltransferase complex

relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: FTO is the first identified RNA demethylase capable of removing the methylation of m6A from mRNA both in vitro and in vivo

key_findings: Review of RNA methylation (m6A, m5C, m1A, m7G, m6Am) writers, erasers and readers and their roles in rheumatic autoimmune diseases.
Aberrant m6A is linked to dysregulated T cell activation and cytokine production.
